description: Class representing custom properties of the document.

Add.description: Adds a custom property to the document with automatic type detection.

returns.description: Returns false if the type is unsupported.

Add.signature: Add(name: string, value: string | number | boolean | Date): boolean

Get.description: Returns the value of a custom property by its name.

returns.description: The value of the custom property or null if the property does not exist.

Get.signature: Get(name: string): string | number | Date | boolean | null

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiCustomProperties class.
